description: This file defines a class 'LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' that subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM system. It reacts specifically when the 'leave' module's status changes, updating related widget permissions on the dashboard.

classes.name: LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber class that listens for module status change events, specifically handling updates related to the 'leave' module.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber is listening to, binding the module status change event to the handler method.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event. If the previous module was 'leave', it updates the dashboard leave widget permissions based on the current module's status.
